_comment: Manifest of custom data this theme depends on. Consumed by provision-shopify-data.mjs. Field types use Shopify's Admin API metafield/metaobject type names directly. Edit here, not in the admin UI, so the repo stays the source of truth.

product_metafields.name: Rating
product_metafields.description: Average star rating (0-5) shown on the shop card. No reviews app is wired up for this build — set by hand or backfill later from a real reviews platform.

product_metafields.name: Review count
product_metafields.description: Number of reviews backing the rating above.

product_metafields.name: Merchandising badge
product_metafields.description: Free-text pill shown on the shop card, e.g. "Best seller", "Top rated", "New". Independent of the sold-out badge, which is computed from stock automatically.

metaobjects.name: Combo
metaobjects.description: A curated multi-product bundle at a fixed promotional price, shown in the Best-selling combos rail.

fieldDefinitions.name: Products
fieldDefinitions.description: Pick 2-3 products for this combo — not enforced by Shopify at the field level for reference lists, so keep it to 2-3 by convention when filling entries in.

fieldDefinitions.name: Item captions
fieldDefinitions.description: One short caption per product, same order as Products, e.g. "Cuts grease instantly".

fieldDefinitions.name: Savings label
fieldDefinitions.description: Free text, e.g. "You save ₹398" or "Biggest saving".

metaobjects.name: Bundle tier
metaobjects.description: One of the fixed-price, pick-N-products pricing tiers shown in the Bundles section.

fieldDefinitions.name: Sample products
fieldDefinitions.description: Small preview thumbnails shown above the tier card.

metaobjects.name: Review
metaobjects.description: One customer review entry for the Reviews rail marquee.
